description: Enhance gateway and worker metrics with all Phase 5 observability counters/gauges/histograms. Adds gateway_requests_total, gateway_request_duration_seconds, gateway_worker_health, gateway_circuit_breaker_state, gateway_cold_start_duration_seconds to GatewayMetrics. Creates new WorkerMetrics in internal/worker/metrics.go with worker_requests_total, worker_request_duration_seconds, worker_config_version, worker_flows_loaded, worker_jdms_loaded, worker_connections_active, worker_reload_total. Wires metrics into existing handler and reload code.
steps: Read engine/internal/gateway/metrics.go to understand existing GatewayMetrics structure (dispatchTotal, dispatchDuration, workerReady, workerReplicas, scaleOperations)

Enhance GatewayMetrics: add requestsTotal *prometheus.CounterVec (labels: group, method, path, status), requestDuration *prometheus.HistogramVec (labels: group), workerHealth *prometheus.GaugeVec (labels: group, worker_id), circuitBreakerState *prometheus.GaugeVec (labels: group), coldStartDuration *prometheus.HistogramVec (labels: group)

Add methods ObserveRequest(group, method, path, status string, duration time.Duration), SetWorkerHealth(group, workerID string, healthy bool), SetCircuitBreakerState(group string, state int), ObserveColdStart(group string, duration time.Duration) to GatewayMetrics

Create engine/internal/worker/metrics.go with WorkerMetrics struct containing: requestsTotal (group, flow_id, status), requestDuration (group, flow_id), configVersion (group), flowsLoaded (group), jdmsLoaded (group), connectionsActive (group, connection), reloadTotal (group, status)

Add methods ObserveRequest(group, flowID, status string, duration time.Duration), SetConfigVersion(group string, version int), SetFlowsLoaded(group string, count int), SetJDMsLoaded(group string, count int), SetConnectionsActive(group, connection string, active int), IncReload(group, status string) to WorkerMetrics
Update engine/internal/worker/worker.go LoadGroup() to call metrics.SetConfigVersion, SetFlowsLoaded, SetJDMsLoaded, SetConnectionsActive after successful load
Update engine/internal/worker/handler.go handleExecute() to call metrics.ObserveRequest after flow execution
Update engine/internal/worker/reload.go to call metrics.IncReload on reload success/failure
Update engine/internal/gateway/scaler.go waitForReady() to track cold start duration: record start time when replicas==0, observe duration when first pod becomes ready
Update engine/internal/gateway/client.go to expose circuit breaker state to metrics via callback or periodic sync
Create engine/internal/gateway/metrics_test.go with tests for new metrics methods
Create engine/internal/worker/metrics_test.go with tests for WorkerMetrics
acceptance_criteria: go build ./cmd/engine && go build ./cmd/worker compiles without errors
go test ./internal/gateway/... passes including new metrics tests
go test ./internal/worker/... passes including new metrics tests

Starting the gateway and curling /metrics shows gateway_requests_total, gateway_request_duration_seconds, gateway_worker_health, gateway_circuit_breaker_state, gateway_cold_start_duration_seconds metrics
Worker /metrics shows worker_requests_total, worker_request_duration_seconds, worker_config_version, worker_flows_loaded, worker_jdms_loaded, worker_connections_active, worker_reload_total metrics
findings:
Implemented Phase 5 metrics enhancement:

1. Enhanced GatewayMetrics with 5 new metrics:
   - gateway_requests_total{group,method,path,status} - HTTP request counter
   - gateway_request_duration_seconds{group} - HTTP request latency histogram
   - gateway_worker_health{group,worker_id} - Individual worker health gauge
   - gateway_circuit_breaker_state{group} - Circuit breaker state (0=closed,1=half-open,2=open)
   - gateway_cold_start_duration_seconds{group} - Cold start latency histogram

2. Created WorkerMetrics in internal/worker/metrics.go with 7 metrics:
   - worker_requests_total{group,flow_id,status}
   - worker_request_duration_seconds{group,flow_id}
   - worker_config_version{group}
   - worker_flows_loaded{group}
   - worker_jdms_loaded{group}
   - worker_connections_active{group,connection}
   - worker_reload_total{group,status}

3. Wired metrics into runtime:
   - Worker.LoadGroup() emits config/flow/jdm/connection metrics
   - Handler.handleExecute() emits request metrics with duration
   - Reloader.reload() emits reload success/failure counter
   - Scaler.ensureDynamicDeployment() tracks cold start duration
   - WorkerClient.Execute() updates circuit breaker state metric

4. Added WorkerClient methods for breaker state:
   - GetBreakerStates() for diagnostics
   - SyncBreakerStateMetrics() for periodic sync
   - SetMetrics() to inject metrics after construction

5. Added tests for all new metrics in both packages.
